description: This file defines the MultipartUploader class for handling multipart uploads to AWS S3, including configuration, part creation, and hashing functionalities.

classes.name: MultipartUploader
classes.description: Handles multipart upload process to AWS S3, including creating parts, managing upload workflow, and hashing streams.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MultipartUploader with client, source, and configuration.

methods.name: loadUploadWorkflowInfo
methods.description: Returns the workflow commands and identifiers for multipart upload.

methods.name: createPart
methods.description: Creates a data array for a specific upload part, including reading from source and hashing.

methods.name: extractETag
methods.description: Extracts the ETag from the upload result.

methods.name: getSourceMimeType
methods.description: Determines the MIME type of the source based on its URI.

methods.name: getSourceSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the source data.

methods.name: decorateWithHashes
methods.description: Wraps a stream with a SHA256 hashing layer and updates the data array with the hash.
